assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The fixture insert loses rows; the independent SQL count differs from 20000. Fixture precondition, not product regression coverage.

Interruption fails to propagate, occurs at another point, or leaves added columns committed so retry skips the 20000-row backfill; removing explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE reproduces the documented retry failure.
Recovered migration loses recent membership; the stored activity query no longer returns 50 rows.

Fixture activity construction no longer yields 50 qualifying records or covers four timestamp positions. The STAMPS-derived assertion is fixture validation only; it does not independently protect runtime timestamp handling.
sync_run misclassifies existing or missing records; updated/inserted literals are independent expected outcomes.
History is missing or row_factory/progress instrumentation cannot see a known 20000-row read; positive-control assertions reject the measurement.

The stored result loses payloads, omits completed_at-only rows, retains an amended stale run, or drops newly active/inserted runs; the independently retained fixture records disagree with the database read. Expected data shares the established ledger timestamp semantics deliberately, rather than asserting against a supplied row bound.
Reinstating the base full-history reader materializes over three times the active count or executes over 200 VM steps per active run; negative-control.log demonstrates all four row bounds failing.
No assertions were added, removed or weakened; batching only replaces fixture writes and existing landing-reader assertions remain unchanged.

evidence_notes: Read exact git objects at the reviewed head: the assigned review worktree HEAD is 859b85a0d26daf37384b5300e842a2e9215c046b and was not treated as the reviewed implementation.

The coordinator resume advice explicitly arms the expanded five-file head cohort; historical broader importer receipts were retained by the worker and were not rerun or represented as final-head coverage.
No tests rerun during review; no repository files modified.
